description: Post-#128 structural ceiling for Insight Hub 2 after browser-CI, dead-code hardening, React 19 state-map compatibility, and OSHA database-persistence hardening. The active application keeps one shell, three global CSS layers, the reviewed component-level style blocks, lazy-loaded workspaces, and the protected Hub 2 intelligence ownership routes. The first-party React 19 state-map workspace replaces the incompatible upstream peer declaration, and the permanent OSHA persistence audit prevents regression to file-cache storage. CinematicPortal remains intentionally retained as a reviewed required production file. Duplicate files, generated artifacts, invalid coordinates, extra app shells, new unreachable frontend files, additional architecture candidates, and additional injected-style files remain prohibited unless this baseline is deliberately reviewed and updated.
